name: admin-profiles-edit-saved
js: const form = document.querySelector('form'); const note = document.createElement('div'); for (const a of form.attributes) { if (a.name.startsWith('_ngcontent')) note.setAttribute(a.name, ''); } note.className = 'alert alert-success'; note.setAttribute('data-testid', 'profile-success-message'); note.textContent = 'Profile updated successfully'; form.after(note);

name: admin-profiles-board-saved
js: const t = document.querySelector('[data-testid=profile-board-title]'); t.value = 'Treasurer'; t.setAttribute('value', 'Treasurer'); const form = document.querySelector('form'); const note = document.createElement('div'); for (const a of form.attributes) { if (a.name.startsWith('_ngcontent')) note.setAttribute(a.name, ''); } note.className = 'alert alert-success'; note.setAttribute('data-testid', 'profile-success-message'); note.textContent = 'Profile updated successfully'; form.after(note);
